## Realistic Tier-2 recall ceiling

Recoverable = group B only (behaviour present in the trace). Labels as used today (all 278 positives).

| scenario | recoverable FN (95% CI) | recall ceiling (95% CI) |
|---|---|---|
| strict: B | ≈ 6 (1–31) | 16.9% (15.1%–25.7%) |
| lenient: B + A with C2 check-in seen | ≈ 30 (13–62) | 25.4% (19.4%–37.0%) |

With the audited labels instead (only malicious-confirmed / -likely count as positives):
